title: Stratos 2026 Takeaways: A new era in business identity
summary: AI makes it easier to fabricate a business’s online presence but it also gives verification teams new tools to investigate, check the evidence and explain their decisions.
body_markdown:
An online merchant can operate without a storefront. A content creator is able to generate revenue across digital platforms without employees or commercial space. A holding company formed to hold a single property doesn’t need a website or active social presence. Those missing details aren’t warning signs anymore and treating them like that can block legitimate applicants whose day-to-day operations simply look different.


Each attribute can mean different things: an active employment lawsuit is largely irrelevant when opening a standard commercial checking account, it could be material when underwriting a line of credit, and it’s critical when issuing liability insurance. The same public record carries completely different weight depending on the product exposure.


The context and history behind each business and related person can explain how the company operates and what risks it can carry. It’s now necessary to look for shared owners, corporate officers, physical operating addresses, and active financing records such as loans and liens. Ongoing evaluations are also needed because all these elements can change with time.
